title: Offers some protection for your table but could have been cuter.
text:
Offers some protection for your table but could have been cuter.. Look/Appearance: These DII gray, woven placemats are simple with a floral design in the center. They are round but would have been cuter if they had a nice border, which would have also made them a little larger. They are lightweight and stack well. *Note: One of mine was a little discolored. It wasn’t worth sending them back and since I usually set the table for 4, it wasn’t a big deal.
Cost: To me, these are a little expensive for what you get. These retail for around $25 ($4 each) on Amazon. You can find some cuter ones for that price.
Care: These are easy to care for. You just wipe them off with a damp cloth.
Overall, these are just ok. I would give them 3 stars.
